about: Motion references for Digi (Nov 18, 2026). Mobbin gives still screen sequences, not video: motion is inferred from consecutive screens. 'confidence' = how sure we are the app animates this way.

refs.learn: Onboarding opens on a black screen with only a glowing orange focus bracket and a big shutter. No copy. The first thing you do is press the shutter.
After the shutter: a rounded card of heavily blurred colour that says 'Developing snaps...'. This is our first-flash develop step: blur, then sharpen.
refs.confidence: high for the blur card, medium for the exact timing

refs.learn: The blurred card resolves into a sharp, flash-lit party photo inside the same card frame. The frame stays still and only the image changes, so it reads as a reveal and not a new screen.

First real capture: the headline swaps to 'You took your first snap', the roll counter goes from 0 to 1 with a pink thumbnail, and ribbon confetti bursts from the bottom. One small celebration, only the first time.
One-tap question tiles: the picked tile turns tinted with a coloured border, and the top progress bar grows by one step on each screen. Copy this pattern for our pixel battery.
refs.confidence: high for the states, medium for the springy fill

refs.learn: Full-bleed colour celebration with a big number ('5 day streak') and a row of day dots ticking in. Template for the 'camera ready' moment and number count-ups.
Big % count-up, a gradient bar and a checklist that ticks item by item ('Calories... Carbs...'). Builds the sense that something is being computed. Use for After Dark developing stages.
AI image edit wait state: a 'Thinking' shimmer label and a soft dot field that pulses. This feels calmer than a spinner. Our version is CCD grain or a scan line over the blurred photo.
refs.confidence: medium (one frame, the motion is implied)

refs.learn: Dark 'You're set up' screen: a tilted phone outline in the brand colour with a warm radial glow behind it. Reference for the 'Your camera's ready' LCD screen: a dark screen, one glowing object and one CTA.
Dark paywall that leads with a before/after visual (bars), then three benefit rows and a single bright CTA. The bars likely grow in on entry.

Three overlapping, slightly tilted cards (the centre one raised) above two plan tiles. The selected tile gets a thick border and a filled radio. The close button is visible on the plan step: never delay it.
refs.confidence: high for the layout, medium for the fan-in

refs.learn: Offer bottom sheet over a dimmed paywall: an illustration header with floating sparkles, a visible close button, one primary button. Pattern for our Party Pack sheet.
